accounting.rationale: PDF124 lines4-6 combines category/declaration definitions with the assumed-rank effective-argument property. No separate no-op category execution is introduced.
DIMENSION can describe a scalar; a zero-size explicit bound vector can establish rank zero. Do not interpret the attribute name as an unconditional array assertion.
Assumed-rank is distinct from assumed-shape and deferred-shape. Its defining contexts and restrictions remain in8.5.8.7.
Ordinary rank, extents, shape and size are distinct from corank and coshape. The original array concepts are in5.4.6.

PENDING source relation to8.5.17 R829/C863/C864 and p2. A RANK clause has its own eligible dummy/ALLOCATABLE/POINTER roles and scalar/deferred/assumed-shape interpretation; no new local execution merely classifies the clause.
R814 selects the actual array-spec form. Definitions do not waive8.2's entity-level specification/override conditions, the individual shape rules, or component-array-spec grammar.
PDF124 lines7-15 gives nine alternatives. Downstream defining R/C ownership is preserved.

Original NOTE1 states that the maximum rank is fifteen minus the same entity's corank; 5.4.6p1 supplies the normative array concept. This note does not create a coarray execution or another mandatory numbered report.
Account for fifteen dimensions before the corank adjustment, without turning processor limits or unsupported facilities into unrelated diagnostics.
The subtraction concerns the same entity's corank, not a dimension extent or a chosen image count. Existing CODIMENSION cases retain their owners.
Original NOTE2 starts on PDF124 and continues as inventory unit note2.2 on PDF125. Its fragmentary examples are not complete programs or new mandatory effects.
EX is a subroutine context. N, LBARRAY and UBARRAY need complete valid prior declarations/association before future examples could become admissions.
W uses scalar explicit bounds and a nonconstant dummy-dependent bound; the automatic-object/SAVE rules remain owned by8.3.

SHAPE(W) supplies a rank-one vector with constant size from W's known rank; its values need not be constant. Restricted inquiry and prior specification premises must be checked, not inferred from a variable name.
The lower-bound vector is paired with a scalar upper bound, with scalar broadcasting supplied by8.5.8.2p3.
Both bound arrays need rank one, integer type, restricted expressions, constant sizes and C832 size agreement.
Vector arithmetic in the entity declaration supplies bounds; do not confuse these vector values with ordinary scalar-bound syntax or use the entity override as duplicate-attribute evidence.
A(:) needs the genuine assumed-shape dummy context; no allocation or local-array shortcut.
B(0:) distinguishes a specified lower bound from the omitted default. Its detailed semantics remain8.5.8.3.
C(LBARRAY:) illustrates the vector-lower assumed-shape form, subject to complete valid dummy and bound-array declarations.
D(:,:) is a deferred-shape pointer. The declaration does not establish association or available shape/bounds.
P uses attribute-list DIMENSION with POINTER; it is not an ordinary nonpointer assumed-shape local.
The actual heading is NOTE2 (cont.), not a third note. The E and V examples remain part of the preceding informative note.
E is deferred shape with ALLOCATABLE. No unallocated payload, shape or bounds inquiry is authorized by its declaration.
V is a named constant with an explicit lower bound and implied extent from its constant initializer. The illustrative real literals do not supply a representation or arithmetic oracle.

requirements.title: An array specification selects one of nine grammar alternatives
requirements.definition: The alternatives are the explicit-shape list and vector-bounds forms, assumed-shape list and vector-bounds forms, deferred-shape list, assumed-size form, implied-shape form, shared implied-shape-or-assumed-size form, and assumed-rank form. Choosing an alternative does not waive its entity-role, expression or association restrictions. Component declarations use their separate component-array-spec production.

pending.explicit-shape-list: PENDING complete ordinary INTEGER declarations with scalar-bound lists, including omitted and explicit lower bounds. Keep R815-R817 owners and meaningful compile/admission roles; an accepted declaration does not prove the runtime bound effects.
pending.explicit-shape-bounds: PENDING R818's upper-vector, two-vector and both scalar/vector mixed forms in ordinary entity declarations. Include a constant zero-size bound vector's scalar interpretation; do not insert vector-bounds syntax into R740 component-array-spec.
pending.assumed-shape-list: PENDING source/admission relation for a nonpointer nonallocatable assumed-shape dummy in a complete explicit interface, including omitted and stated lower bounds. Preserve R820 and8.5.8.3 ownership; no new detailed catalogue for that subclause.
pending.assumed-shape-bounds: PENDING complete dummy/interface context for R821 with a rank-one integer restricted bound vector of constant size. Read its scalar zero-size boundary under8.5.8.3 rather than assuming every colon-containing declaration is an array.
pending.deferred-shape-list: PENDING separate POINTER and ALLOCATABLE admissions under R822/C834. No value/bounds/shape query before the actual intrinsic's association or allocation conditions are satisfied; no cloned allocation fixture.
pending.assumed-size: PENDING R824's explicit-shape prefix followed by an assumed-implied-spec, in a genuine dummy context. Retain C835/C836, rank and last-dimension limitations; do not request SHAPE of the assumed-size array.
pending.implied-shape: PENDING R826's multiple assumed-implied specifications in a named constant declaration with a conforming rank-matched constant initializer. A prior fully specified rank-two INTEGER named constant can supply the initializer; no variable or allocatable substitute.
pending.shared-implied-assumed-size: PENDING R825's single assumed-implied specification in each permitted context: dummy data object and named constant. The spelling alone does not decide the context or authorize an ordinary local variable; C837 and the respective downstream rules retain ownership.
pending.assumed-rank: PENDING R827 '..' in a complete dummy/interface context, without VALUE or CODIMENSION and with C840-compliant uses. This is not assumed-shape, an invented fixed-rank proxy, or a permission for an ordinary local object to have unknown rank.

requirements.oracle: Finite grammar admissions and exact canonical source relations. A future syntax negative must exclude all valid alternative parses and have a minimally repaired valid control; no negative is invented for every permitted alternative.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No source-use record, execution or facet credit is created here. Existing R/C cases cannot be relabelled or cloned merely to populate this grammar selector. Numbered reporting is a capability, not mandated fatal exit, code or English wording; unsupported language features, crashes, echoes and unrelated recovery do not count.

requirements.title: An assumed-rank dummy derives rank, shape and size from its effective argument
requirements.source: 8.5.8.1 p1 effective-argument clause, physical PDF124, lines4-6
requirements.definition: An assumed-rank dummy data object has the rank, shape and size of its effective argument. This does not assert equality of all lower bounds, invent a shape for an assumed-size argument, or make unavailable allocatable/pointer properties available. Inquiry procedures retain their own argument requirements and special result conventions.

pending.scalar-effective-argument: PENDING a defined INTEGER scalar passed through an explicit interface to an assumed-rank INTENT(IN) dummy. Direct RANK is zero and SHAPE has rank one and size zero; SIZE on the assumed-rank dummy without DIM is one via SIZE/PRODUCT's empty-product rule. Do not pass an ordinary scalar directly to SIZE or supply an invalid DIM.
pending.rank-one-effective-argument: PENDING a defined rank-one INTEGER actual with three elements, expecting dummy RANK=1, SHAPE=[3], SIZE=3 through permitted direct inquiries. Nonunit actual lower bounds are not promised to transfer to an ordinary nonpointer dummy.
pending.rank-two-shape-order: PENDING a defined INTEGER whole array of shape [2,3], expecting actual dummy RANK=2, SHAPE=[2,3], SIZE=6. Use literal expected rank/extents/size, not a constructor RANK or a fixed-rank destination as a proxy.
pending.zero-extent-effective-argument: PENDING a valid whole array with shape [0,4], expecting rank2, that ordered shape and total size0 in the assumed-rank dummy. No element is read or written, and no allocation or pointer-state precondition is bypassed.
pending.assumed-size-inquiry-boundary: PENDING exact canonical source relation for forwarding an assumed-size argument to an assumed-rank dummy. SHAPE's final -1 and SIZE's corresponding conventions are inquiry sentinels, not a recovered actual upper bound or total element count. Lock any runtime expectation only after the complete SIZE/SHAPE/PRODUCT and argument premises are independently approved.
pending.allocatable-pointer-state-source-use: PENDING the specific ALLOCATABLE/POINTER dummy/actual rules of8.5.8.4/.7 and15.5.2.6. RANK alone and permitted shape/size inquiries have different state premises. Preserve existing allocation/association owners; no unallocated or disassociated shape/value observation and no new no-op classifier.

requirements.oracle: Actual assumed-rank dummy inquiries on complete conforming calls, with independently fixed small integer expectations. The scalar and empty-array routes have different rank, shape and size; array lower bounds follow the applicable argument rules, not a generalized shape-copy assertion.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No runtime effect is weakened to compile-only because a processor lacks the language feature. Pure source-use gates and intrinsic sentinel conventions grant no execution/facet credit. Avoid optional/not-present actuals, undefined values, escaped pointers, coarray proxies and descriptor-derived expected results.
